# Swift AI Humanizer — Full Technical Specification & API Guidelines

> Complete technical documentation for AI models, web crawlers, and LLM agent integration.

## Architecture & Algorithm

Swift AI Humanizer is built on peer-reviewed Natural Language Processing research ("How to Detect AI-Generated Texts?", Nguyen, Hatua & Sung, 2023). It targets 10 key NLP features analyzed by modern AI detectors:

1. **Coleman-Liau Readability Index**: Calibrates letter-to-word and word-to-sentence ratios into human ranges.
2. **Vocabulary Entropy & POS Density**: Rebalances noun-to-verb-to-adjective distributions.
3. **Burstiness & Perplexity**: Introduces sentence length variations to eliminate artificial uniform rhythm.
4. **Transition Filtering**: Replaces formal AI cliché transitions ("moreover", "in summary") with natural human bridges.
5. **Formatting Preservation**: Preserves AST Markdown nodes line-by-line during transformation.
